title: Physics2Weight: Direct Neural Network Architecture and Weight Generation from Physical Laws Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.12954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled weight-space programming (WSP), which directly generates neural network weights without gradient-based optimization. However, extending WSP to physical problems remains challenging, particularly in achieving both solution accuracy and physical consistency. In this paper, we propose Physics2Weight (PtW), a framework that extends WSP to solving partial differential equations by directly generating neural network weights and editing architectures based on governing equations and initial and boundary conditions. PtW introduces physics-constrained prompting and physics-guided architecture editing, combined with iterative weight refinement from WSP, to improve solution accuracy and physical consistency without gradient-based optimization. tldr: 该论文提出Physics2Weight（PtW）框架，利用大语言模型根据控制方程及初始边界条件直接生成神经网络权重并编辑架构，通过物理约束提示、物理引导的架构编辑和迭代权重细化，在无需梯度优化的情况下实现更高精度和物理一致性的偏微分方程求解。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Physics2Weight (PtW), a framework that leverages large language models to directly generate neural network weights and edit architectures based on governing equations and initial/boundary conditions, combining physics-constrained prompting, physics-guided architecture editing, and iterative weight refinement to solve PDEs with higher accuracy and physical consistency without gradient-based optimization.
